general.title: General Settings
general.zoomDescription: Adjusts the zoom level to make content easier to read.
general.autoUpdateDescription: This will automatically update the app when new versions are available.
general.releaseChannelDescription: Controls which update channel the app uses.
general.runtimeModeDescription: Select the runtime to use for running the app.
general.nodeConfigured: Node.js is properly configured and ready to use.
general.nodeSelectFolder: Select the folder where Node.js is installed if it's not in your system PATH.
general.customAppsFolderDescription: This is the top-level folder that Minerva will store new applications in.
general.customAppsFolderUnavailable: Your apps folder is inaccessible. Make sure that the folder exists and has write permissions, or change it.
general.customAppsFolderInvalid: Unable to use selected folder. Please ensure it is a valid directory with write permissions.

general.customAppsFolderResetFailed: Failed to reset Minerva apps folder path: {{error}}
general.restartRequiredDescription: You will need to restart Minerva for your settings to take effect.
general.stableChannelToastDescription: You will stay on your current version until a newer stable release is available, or you can manually downgrade now.

workflow.title: Workflow Settings
workflow.defaultChatModeDescription: Controls the default chat mode when you open a new chat.
workflow.autoApproveDescription: This will automatically approve code changes and run them.
workflow.autoFixProblemsDescription: This will automatically fix TypeScript errors.
workflow.autoApproveDisableHint: You can disable auto-approve in Settings.
workflow.autoFixDisableHint: You can disable Auto-fix problems in the Settings page.
workflow.autoExpandPreviewDescription: Automatically expand the preview panel when code changes are made.
workflow.chatEventNotificationDescription: Show native notifications when a chat response completes or a questionnaire needs your input while the app is not focused.

ai.title: AI Settings
ai.thinkingBudgetDescription: Controls how long the AI model can think. Higher budgets mean more thorough reasoning.
ai.imageGenerationProviderDescription: Choose which provider handles image generation requests.
ai.imageGenerationModelDescription: Choose the default model used when Minerva generates images.
ai.maxChatTurnsDescription: Limits how many recent chat turns are included in context.
ai.maxToolCallStepsDescription: Limits how many tool calls the agent can make before pausing.
ai.connectCustomEndpoint: Connect to a custom LLM API endpoint
ai.deleteProviderConfirmation: This will permanently delete this custom provider and all its associated models. This action cannot be undone.
ai.providerNotFoundDescription: The provider with ID "{{provider}}" could not be found.

low.label: Low
low.description: Minimal thinking tokens for faster responses and lower costs.

high.label: High
high.description: Extended thinking for complex problems requiring deep analysis.

economy.label: Economy (2)
economy.description: Minimal context to reduce token usage and improve response times.

default.label: Default ({{count}})
default.description: Balanced context size for most conversations.

plus.label: Plus (5)
plus.description: Slightly higher context size for detailed conversations.

high.label: High (10)
high.description: Extended context for complex conversations requiring more history.

max.label: Max (100)
max.description: Maximum context (not recommended due to cost and speed).

low.label: Low (25)
low.description: Limits tool calls to 25. Good for simple tasks that don't need many steps.

high.label: High (200)
high.description: Extended limit for complex multi-step tasks (may increase cost and time).

ai.contextCompactionDescription: Automatically compact long conversations to stay within context limits. Original messages are preserved in the app data directory.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: This records anonymous usage data to improve the product.
telemetry.privacyNotice: We use anonymous telemetry data to improve the product. No personal data is collected.
telemetry.helpImprove: Help improve Minerva with anonymous usage data.
telemetry.noCodeOrMessages: Note: this does not log your code or messages.

experiments.title: Experiments

experiments.blockUnsafeNpmPackagesDescription: Use socket.dev to detect unsafe packages and block them.
experiments.enableMcpServersForBuildMode: Enable MCP servers for Build mode
experiments.enableMcpServersForBuildModeDescription: Allow MCP servers to be used in Build mode. Note: MCP servers are always enabled in Agent mode.
experiments.enableSelectAppFromHomeChatInput: Enable Select App from Home Chat Input
experiments.enableSelectAppFromHomeChatInputDescript: Show an app selector in the home chat input to start a chat referencing an existing app.

dangerZone.resetDescription: This will delete all your apps, chats, and settings. This action cannot be undone.

dangerZone.resetSuccess: Successfully reset everything. Restart the application.
